provenance.source: National Energy Code of Canada for Buildings 2025, Division B, Subsection 8.4.5 (reference building) - retrieved via the building-codes MCP server (necb:2025), Tables 8.4.5.7.-A/-B/8.4.5.13 and Articles 8.4.5.6-8.4.5.18
provenance.note: NECB 2025 renumbered the performance path: reference-building HVAC rules moved from Subsection 8.4.4 (2020) to 8.4.5; part-load curves moved to 8.4.6. All rule VALUES verified identical to 2020 via MCP retrieval and edition diff (selection tables byte-identical; oversizing 30%/10%; fan specs 640Pa/40% and 1000Pa/55%+250Pa/30%; boiler staging 176/352 kW; furnace/DX staging 66 kW; chiller plant 2100 kW/7C/6C; tower 1750 kW cells; HP -10C cutoff). Wording change: the supply-fan rule now reads *HVAC systems 1 to 5* (2020: *1, 3, 4 and 5*) - same effective coverage.
provenance.efficiency_fallback_reason: NECB 2025 Table 5.2.12.1.-A (unitary equipment) changed significantly vs 2020 (MCP diff: similarity 0.77, headers restructured - SEER2/EER2 metric transition); the 2025 minimum-performance tables are not yet transcribed. apply_efficiencies falls back to 2020 values with an audit warning.

selection.default_category_article: 8.4.5.7.(3): 'If the building or space type ... is not listed in Table 8.4.5.7.-A, the type that most closely corresponds to that thermal block shall be used'

rules.article: 8.4.5.7.-A: 'Where the proposed building or space has a cooling capacity exceeding 20 kW, the reference building or space shall use System 2'
8.4.5.7.-A: 'food preparation with kitchen hood or vented appliance -> System 4'

heated_only.text: Where the proposed building or space is heated only, the reference building or space shall use System 1.

compatible_cooling.text: Where ... heated as well as being cooled with an air-cooled unitary, packaged terminal or room air conditioner (or heat pumps), or fan coils, the reference ... shall be modeled as being identical to that of the proposed building or space

otherwise.text: otherwise, the reference building or space shall use through-the-wall systems.

heat_pump.text: Where the proposed ... includes an air-source, water-source or ground-source heat pump ..., the reference building's HVAC system for that thermal block shall be an air-source heat pump described in Table 8.4.5.13 (packaged unitary rooftop heat pump, CV, furnace + baseboards auxiliary). System 2 selections keep Table 8.4.5.7.-B.

purchased_heating.text: one gas-fired modulating boiler complying with Section 5.2. shall be used to represent the purchased energy equipment

purchased_cooling.text: one air-cooled electric chiller ... shall be used to represent the purchased energy equipment
